title: Roster Group Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An employee's membership of a roster group for a period. The employee follows the group's schedule for the dates covered, unless they have their own duty period or a substitute duty.

fields.label: RosterGroup
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Roster Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The roster group.

Example. Team A

fields.label: Employee
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.
fields.html:
What it is. The employee.

Why it matters. An employee's periods in the same roster group cannot overlap.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same roster group and employee.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.
